run_english_alternate_agent: run the EnglishAlternateAgent simuleval speech-to-speech agent with a specified wait-seconds argument
synthesize_text_with_tts: synthesize speech audio from text input using the TTSModel class with fastspeech2 and hifigan vocoder
build_tts_model_from_hf_hub: build a TTSModel that loads the facebook/fastspeech2-en-ljspeech model ensemble from HuggingFace Hub
create_speech_segment: create a SpeechSegment containing audio samples, sample rate, and finished flag for speech-to-speech output
configure_agent_wait_seconds: configure the EnglishAlternateAgent with a custom wait-seconds argument via argparse
